text: 日本经济财政大臣城内实：希望日本央行在政策引导方面继续与政府保持密切沟通。 鉴于日本央行决定结束收益率曲线控制，日本已不再需要实施非常规货币刺激措施。 日本已不再处于通缩状态，因此无需采取过度宽松、推高通胀的货币政策。 高市政府的政策不同于旨在使日本摆脱通缩的再通胀政策。 高市政府的政策不同于安倍经济学，力求同时实现强劲经济和财政纪律，侧重提升日本的供给能力。
text_en: Japan's Minister of State for Economic and Fiscal Policy Minoru Kiuchi: He hopes the Bank of Japan will continue to maintain close communication with the government in policy guidance. Given the Bank of Japan's decision to end yield curve control, Japan no longer needs to implement unconventional monetary stimulus measures. Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for excessively accommodative monetary policy that pushes up inflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from reflationary policies aimed at pulling Japan out of deflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from Abenomics, seeking to achieve both a strong economy and fiscal discipline, with a focus on enhancing Japan's supply capacity.
